papersim.rule: buys at observation id > epoch use v2; earlier observations and their positions stay v1; None => v1

quality.rule: observations with id > epoch are validated (v1) and quarantined rows never reach the engine; None => v0

evaluation.rule: after the epoch every champion/selection/promotion uses only evidence whose entry/decision observation id > evaluation_epoch; older evidence is kept, displayed and labelled pre_epoch_contaminated
